name: postfader-fl-studio-mcp
description: All-around FL Studio MCP for verified control, mixing, composition, and arrangement.
long_description: A local 90-tool MCP server and MIDI bridge for inspecting and controlling FL Studio, diagnosing real bounces, building and applying reviewable mix plans, composing deterministic parts, exporting verified MIDI, and driving FL's optional Piano Roll script runtime. Direct setters keep later-tick readback and mutations remain disabled until the present user enables write mode for that bridge session. Before opening this extension, install the matching Python package and run `postfader setup`; the .mcpb does not deploy FL Studio's controller script or configure a virtual MIDI endpoint.

midi_port.title: Virtual MIDI endpoint
midi_port.description: Exact endpoint name shared with FL Studio. PostFader does not install or configure a virtual MIDI provider.

fl_studio_user_data_dir.title: FL Studio user-data directory
fl_studio_user_data_dir.description: Absolute path to the FL Studio user-data directory containing Settings/Hardware.

tools.name: fl_get_capabilities
tools.description: Report direct, partial, unavailable, and unvalidated integration paths.

tools.name: fl_get_project_summary
tools.description: Read project metadata, counts, dirty state, version, and transport state.

tools.name: fl_get_transport_state
tools.description: Read playback, recording, loop mode, position, and song length.

tools.name: fl_get_selected_range
tools.description: Read raw endpoints and PPQ without claiming meter or rendering semantics.

tools.name: fl_list_mixer_tracks
tools.description: List mixer tracks, current levels, selection state, and loaded effects.

tools.name: fl_inspect_mixer_track
tools.description: Read one track's state, effects, built-in EQ, and outgoing routes.

tools.name: plugins_scan_loaded_plugins
tools.description: Inventory loaded plug-ins without inserting or changing anything.

tools.name: plugins_inspect_parameter_map
tools.description: Read a bounded page of exposed parameters; never marks unknown controls safe.

tools.name: plugins_scan_parameters
tools.description: De-pad a whole plug-in in one call; prefer this over paging a VST.

tools.name: copilot_capture_readonly_inspection
tools.description: Capture a compact project, mixer, and effect inspection report.

tools.name: fl_set_write_mode
tools.description: Enable or disable writes for this bridge session without restarting FL.

tools.name: fl_set_mixer_volume
tools.description: Set one mixer fader and report the readback FL gave on a later tick.

tools.name: fl_set_mixer_volume_db
tools.description: Search FL's fader curve and prove the requested dB value on a later tick.

tools.name: fl_set_mixer_pan
tools.description: Set one mixer pan and report the readback FL gave on a later tick.

tools.name: fl_set_mixer_mute
tools.description: Set one track's mute state and report the readback FL gave on a later tick.

tools.name: fl_set_mixer_solo
tools.description: Set one mixer track's solo state and verify it on a later FL tick.

tools.name: fl_set_mixer_arm
tools.description: Set recording arm with one bounded toggle and later-tick readback.

tools.name: fl_set_mixer_color
tools.description: Set a mixer color, accepting FL-owned differences in the high byte.

tools.name: fl_set_mixer_stereo_separation
tools.description: Set stereo separation and report FL's later-tick readback.

tools.name: fl_select_mixer_track
tools.description: Make one mixer track active and verify the active-track getter.

tools.name: fl_set_track_eq
tools.description: Set gain and/or frequency on one built-in EQ band; at least one is required.

tools.name: fl_set_mixer_name
tools.description: Rename one mixer track.

tools.name: fl_set_mixer_send
tools.description: Route one mixer track to another, or stop routing it there.

tools.name: fl_set_mixer_send_level
tools.description: Set how much of one track reaches another. 0.8 is unity, as on the fader.

tools.name: fl_set_plugin_param_display
tools.description: Set a plug-in parameter using the units it displays, not a 0..1 guess.

tools.name: fl_set_plugin_param_option
tools.description: Set a parameter that shows words rather than numbers: Key, Scale, Input Type.

tools.name: fl_set_plugin_param
tools.description: Set one plug-in parameter; verified from FL's display string changing.

tools.name: fl_apply_verified_batch
tools.description: Apply a closed-union batch after one session preflight, without replay.

tools.name: fl_set_playing
tools.description: Set playback to an absolute state and verify it on a later FL idle tick.

tools.name: fl_stop
tools.description: Stop playback, set normalized position to zero, and verify both fields.

tools.name: fl_set_song_position
tools.description: Set a stopped transport's absolute normalized playhead position.

tools.name: fl_set_loop_mode
tools.description: Set Pattern or Song loop mode without exposing FL's toggle-only API.

tools.name: fl_set_tempo
tools.description: Set project tempo while stopped and verify BPM on a later FL idle tick.

tools.name: fl_set_recording
tools.description: Set recording absolutely; FL's toggle is dispatched at most once.

tools.name: fl_set_metronome
tools.description: Set the metronome absolutely and prove the later UI state.

tools.name: fl_set_precount
tools.description: Set recording precount absolutely and verify it on a later FL tick.

tools.name: fl_set_time_signature_numerator
tools.description: Set and prove beats per bar from FL's PPB/PPQ getter pair.

tools.name: fl_get_project_history
tools.description: Read undo/redo bounds, current history position, hint, and dirty state.

tools.name: fl_undo
tools.description: Move to the previous absolute undo-history position and verify it.

tools.name: fl_redo
tools.description: Move to the next absolute undo-history position and verify it.

tools.name: fl_get_plugin_preset_count
tools.description: Read FL's authoritative preset count for one loaded plug-in.

tools.name: fl_list_channels
tools.description: List globally addressed channels, mix state, routing, and generator identity.

tools.name: fl_list_patterns
tools.description: List pattern identity, length, current state, and empty/default status.

tools.name: fl_find_empty_pattern
tools.description: Find the first default-empty pattern without changing the current pattern.

tools.name: fl_select_pattern
tools.description: Select one pattern and verify FL's current-pattern getter.

tools.name: fl_set_pattern_identity
tools.description: Set pattern name and/or color with per-field later-tick proof.

tools.name: fl_set_pattern_length
tools.description: Set pattern length using Image-Line's API 39+ getter/setter pair.

tools.name: fl_list_playlist_tracks
tools.description: List every one-based Playlist track and its controllable state.

tools.name: fl_set_playlist_track_identity
tools.description: Set Playlist name and/or color with per-field later-tick proof.

tools.name: fl_set_playlist_track_state
tools.description: Set Playlist states; toggle-only selection is dispatched at most once.

tools.name: fl_set_channel_mix
tools.description: Set channel volume, pan, and/or mute with per-field readback proof.

tools.name: fl_set_channel_solo
tools.description: Set a global channel solo state and verify it on a later FL tick.

tools.name: fl_set_channel_pitch
tools.description: Set normalized channel pitch and report normalized/semitone readback.

tools.name: fl_select_channel
tools.description: Select one global channel exclusively and verify the complete selection.

tools.name: fl_set_channel_identity
tools.description: Set a channel's name and/or color with per-field readback proof.

tools.name: fl_route_channel_to_mixer
tools.description: Set one global channel's absolute mixer destination and verify it.

tools.name: fl_get_step_sequence
tools.description: Read an explicit current-pattern/channel grid and its conflict digest.

tools.name: fl_set_step_sequence
tools.description: Set absolute current-pattern cells only if the observed grid digest still matches.

tools.name: fl_trigger_note
tools.description: Audition a global channel with a bounded note-on/off dispatch receipt.

tools.name: audio_analyze_file
tools.description: Measure level, spectrum, dynamics, stereo, and optional pitch of one render.

tools.name: audio_compare_files
tools.description: Measure band deltas over the aligned, loudness-matched common overlap.

tools.name: audio_analyze_masking
tools.description: Measure per-band spectral overlap and vocal-minus-instrument level margins.

tools.name: audio_find_recent_bounces
tools.description: List the newest audio files in FL Studio's Rendered, Audio, and Projects folders.

tools.name: mix_doctor
tools.description: Diagnose a real bounce with explicit policy thresholds and no mutation.

tools.name: mix_reference_recommendations
tools.description: Return bounded tonal review ranges only when alignment/readiness passes.

tools.name: mix_masking_recommendations
tools.description: Recommend bounded dynamic remediation from sample-synchronous stems.

tools.name: mix_start_peak_watch
tools.description: Start a process-persistent sampled peak watch and return its first frame.

tools.name: mix_get_peak_watch
tools.description: Read cumulative sampled peaks without stopping the watch.

tools.name: mix_stop_peak_watch
tools.description: Stop one process-local watch and return its final aggregate.

tools.name: mix_create_gain_stage_plan
tools.description: Create, but do not apply, dB-fader changes from a peak watch.

tools.name: mix_list_plugin_profiles
tools.description: List bundled parameter-role adapters and processing recipes.

tools.name: mix_inspect_plugin_compatibility
tools.description: Report which loaded effects have known parameter-role adapters.

tools.name: mix_resolve_processing_intent
tools.description: Map an intent to loaded profiled controls without applying settings.

tools.name: mix_create_plan
tools.description: Store a session-bound closed-union plan; no project value changes.

tools.name: mix_get_plan
tools.description: Read one process-local reviewable plan.

tools.name: mix_apply_plan
tools.description: Apply a plan once through the verified batch kernel.

tools.name: mix_finish_assessment
tools.description: Run the end-to-end read-only finish assessment and stop at user export.

tools.name: piano_roll_bridge
tools.description: Manage the one-time-per-process arm for FL's separate Piano Roll script runtime.

tools.name: piano_roll_write_notes
tools.description: Generate a typed Piano Roll script, select its target, and report hotkey dispatch honestly.

tools.name: piano_roll_transform
tools.description: Quantize, transpose, humanize, duplicate, delete, or clear selected/all notes.

tools.name: compose_chord_progression
tools.description: Generate voice-led triads/sevenths without changing FL.

tools.name: compose_melody
tools.description: Generate a bounded scale-aware melody without changing FL.

tools.name: compose_bassline
tools.description: Generate a bounded bass part from Roman harmony without changing FL.

tools.name: compose_drums
tools.description: Generate GM-mapped kick/snare/hat patterns without changing FL.

tools.name: midi_export_type1
tools.description: Write a standard Type-1 file, reopen it, parse it, and verify its digest/events.

tools.name: audio_estimate_tempo_and_key
tools.description: Estimate periodic tempo and global major/minor key with ranked ambiguity.

tools.name: audio_transcribe_melody
tools.description: Extract a reviewable note sequence from monophonic audio; it does not mutate FL.

tools.name: arrangement_prepare_pattern
tools.description: Find an FL-reported empty pattern, select it, name/color it, and set length.

tools.name: arrangement_add_section_markers
tools.description: Add bar/beat section markers; name readback is available, marker-time readback is not.

tools.name: automation_record_value
tools.description: Dispatch one REC_MIDIController value while playback and recording are active.
